release_notes: Ban 0.0.36: tang cuong bao mat va do tin cay — (1) chan zip-slip khi phuc hoi sao luu va khi dung PDF tu goi ZIP cua nha cung cap: tu choi entry chua '..', duong dan tuyet doi, ten o dia Windows va moi duong dan ghi ra ngoai thu muc dich; (2) ma so thue duoc kiem tra chat (10/13 chu so, hau to -ql) truoc khi dung lam ten thu muc, MST la bao loi ro thay vi tao duong dan sai; (3) ngay lap khong hop le bao loi thay vi lang le luu vao thang hien tai; (4) kiem tra 'tep nam trong thu muc' dung realpath + commonpath thay cho startswith; (5) updater chi dung khoa cong khai Ed25519 NHUNG TRONG CODE de xac thuc manifest (khong doc khoa tu update_config.json nua); khi chua nhung khoa, app chi kiem SHA-256 va ghi canh bao ro rang.
